action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with budget 100 and no incumbent; probing (~12% of budget) will reveal modality and smoothness before committing. Deterministic, cheap evaluations make probes efficient and their data seeds warm starts.

Probes show large variation (log10_range=3.671) with a moderate funnel signal (fdc_spearman=0.636) but the top-10 are widely spread (spread_vs_uniform=0.8918), suggesting multiple basins. Racing CMA-ES, TuRBO, and GP-BO will hedge and pick the strongest global driver quickly within 48 evals.

CMA-ES won the race and reached 204.76 at eval 30, while others were much worse (turbo 724, gp_bo 954). The active CMA-ES is not converged (sigma=2.42, popsize=10, generation=2) and has only 20 tells; with 58 evals left, it deserves another round before considering a restart or polish.

Only 8 evaluations remain, and CMA-ES just improved the best from 204.763 to 150.952 over its 50-eval tenure (improvement 53.81) with sigma still 1.97 and not converged. Local polishers in 10D are unlikely to be effective with 8 evals, whereas continuing CMA-ES can still yield marginal gains. We'll spend the remaining budget on the active method.
